notes.title: Coming Soon to Steam! "Seeds of Paradise"!
notes.content:
If you've read our "Sylvie's Bar" doujinshi [url=https://twitter.com/OfOutism]and keep up with our lore on social media[/url], you'll know that there's another monster girl brothel named "Seeds of Paradise." Our short (free) eroge starring said brothel and its sassy owner with a foul attitude is coming to Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2721150/Seeds_of_Paradise/

Please consider giving it a wishlist, and leave a review once it comes out if you like what you read. It's another carefully crafted bite-sized look into our world full of lovely lusty monster girls.

notes.title: Bonus Illustration by TUS: "The Mischievious Childhood Friend"
Launch Sale!
notes.content:
[i][b]HELLO MONSTER-LOVERS.[/b][/i]

There was a technical difficulty when launching "Slay the Dragon!" and the 20% off discount was originally not applied. This has been fixed, and will continue on for the next week.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and hope you'll take the opportunity to scoop up our new IP if you haven't already.

On another note, reviews are always appreciated, as there's no length requirement and all feedback is useful to help make our future titles even better.

Till next time.

notes.title: Dr. Doot returns to compose for "Slay the Dragon!"
notes.content:
Dr. Doot, who composed for a previous IP "Seeds of Paradise" is returning to compose for "Slay the Dragon! The Fire-Breathing Tyrant Meets Her Match!" 

Dr. Doot is responsible for "Sunflower Girls," "Strawberry Mist" and did a great deal of the SFX and sound design for our title "Garden of Roses"!

[previewyoutube=wVLIniyjoVM;full][/previewyoutube]

We're very pleased to have him, and have no doubt the soundtrack for "Slay the Dragon!" will be absolutely killer.

Stay tuned!
